name: check_witness

test_list.description: `ApprovalWitness::new(` under crates/polaris-sdk/ and crates/polaris-kernel/crates/verifier/ is allowed.
A call in any other crate or app is reported as path:line.
Files under target/ directories are not scanned.
A tree without calls outside the allowed crates yields no violations.

output_description: Violations as `relative/path.rs:line`, sorted; empty when the typestate's sealing rule holds.
